approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in HNK-LINGUAS after the L02 pedagogy source contract and ten communicative intents were presented.

decisions_requested.statement: Approve the 16-item teachable source set for L02 while keeping VANUVALI and VANI excluded from teachable vocabulary until their semantics are separately governed.
Approve the ten communicative OPI intent targets as the pedagogical scope for Chokhmah before any HNK sentence pattern is authored.
Approve reuse of AN, EN, KUVAN, KU and KE only within their existing scoped CANDIDATE meanings; do not infer a complete pronoun or interrogative grammar.
Approve PA only as the recovered lexical anchor 'ontem'; do not infer a productive past tense or tense morphology from its use in L02.
Approve PITSA as a controlled concrete loanword example without using it to generalize borrowing or food morphology.
Keep WATCH/CANDIDATE authority metadata visible in all later L02 pedagogy artifacts and do not silently promote PARAZAMI, SAROSARI, PARI, PA, AN, EN, KUVAN, KU or KE.
Confirm that this gate authorizes only the next evidence-first sentence-pattern review; it does not itself implement OPI, Story, Q&A, Structures, Vocabulary cards, Activation or Review slots.
Confirm that Biblical Hebrew, Koine Greek and Esperanto remain comparison/reference layers and do not select L02 forms or sentence order.
